command: APK=$(adb shell pm path pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge | head -n1 | sed 's/^package://'); REMOTE=/data/local/tmp/aicallbridge-downlink-test.pcm; adb shell rm -f $REMOTE; adb shell "CLASSPATH=$APK app_process /system/bin pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge.ShellAudioProbe capture-downlink 250 $REMOTE"; adb shell 'wc -c /data/local/tmp/aicallbridge-downlink-test.pcm; rm -f /data/local/tmp/aicallbridge-downlink-test.pcm'
